title: Panel Conflict Disclosure
use_case: Conflict, authority, and mandatory legal certification disclosure for Legal Skyes AE committee members before panel assignment.

questionnaire.label: Verified Legal Certification or Licensure Status

sections.heading: Member Disclosure
sections.body: {{member_name}} / {{member_email}}. Verified legal certification or licensure status: {{credential_status}}. Legal Skyes AE committee case assignment is not permitted until this status is verified.

sections.heading: Conflict Review
sections.body: Financial interest: {{financial_interest}}. Prior customer, affiliate, referral, commission, personal, vendor, employment, public-statement, or competitive relationships: {{prior_relationships}}.

sections.heading: No Unauthorized Practice
sections.body: {{upl_acknowledgment}} Legal Skyes AEs may organize facts, evidence, timelines, and internal recommendation packets. They may not provide legal advice, interpret legal rights, represent any party, threaten legal action, draft individualized legal strategy, or present themselves as attorneys, arbitrators, mediators, or legal document preparers unless properly licensed or certified and separately authorized.

sections.heading: Owner Approval
sections.body: Owner/admin approval is required before recommendation reliance or payout release.
